source: operator-supplied audited spot OHLCV CSV; no network retrieval

experiments.hypothesis: Large relative-volume bullish close near the bar high predicts positive 3-bar forward spot return net of friction and above matched BTC.
A breach below the previous 30-bar low that recovers inside the range predicts 2-bar positive spot reversal versus matched BTC.
Bullish recovery candle still materially below 24-bar rolling typical-price volume-weighted reference predicts a 2-bar rebound versus BTC.

decision_rule.inconclusive_when: insufficient completed events or independent calendar weeks or symbols; descriptive cluster interval spans zero; costs stress fails
decision_rule.family_wise_error_control: three trials; independent review must control family-wise error; descriptive interval is not a calibrated hypothesis test

design.dependence_cluster: UTC ISO calendar week across all symbols
design.design_units: bps of per-trade net excess versus same-window BTC spot long
design.power_estimate: NOT ESTABLISHED; 12 weeks is a minimum evidence gate, not proof of adequate statistical power

source_requirements.timestamp_semantics: UTC bar open; signal after full bar close; next-bar-open hypothetical entry; exit after fixed holding bars at open

notes: Draft protocol, not a pre-registration; only a later version frozen before an unused future window can be prospective.
A fixed 20 bps round-trip spot friction is an illustrative conservative starting assumption, not calibrated venue execution.
No stops or intrabar fills are assumed; entries and exits are next-bar-open references and require independent executable-fill replication.
BTC same-window matched comparison controls some market movement, not altcoin beta, sector, selection, or funding.
Development output is spent data. Do not relabel it prospective.
